msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a elegant Spanish woman in her fifties). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia suenos-de-rosas-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): An elegant Spanish woman in her fifties wearing a cream teddy faux fur short coat with flared blue jeans and white pointed boots from the reference, walking at a sunny street in the centre of Benifaió, Valencia, Spain, with orange trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia suenos-de-rosas-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a long light grey wool coat over black trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia suenos-de-rosas-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a grey knit cardigan with matching wide grey trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 2 «p6» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a tan suede tote bag with leather handles (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «l1» (formato 3:4, referencia suenos-de-rosas-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing a denim shirt with flared blue jeans and a tan suede tote bag from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Benifaió, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia suenos-de-rosas-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing rails of camel, brown and grey coats under backlit white shelves with leather handbags from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Benifaió, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a bright white fashion boutique with backlit white shelving, rails of camel, grey and black coats, leather handbags on the shelves, a light grey wooden floor and a black and white staircase, no people, no text, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
